name: Fudai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Fudai village emblem in white: a ring with eight radiating spokes enclosing three discs.
history: Municipal flag of Fudai, a village in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 January 1964.

features.role: Fudai village emblem — a ring with eight radiating spokes enclosing three discs
